summary: The framework has one class, SFAuthorization, which asks the system to authorize and preauthorize named rights for privileged operations. BifrOSt enforces per-app manifest permissions in the shell and has no SDK call for an app to check or request an authorization right; the nearest app-facing feature is the permission-gated keychain.

features.feature: SFAuthorization object and rights (obtain(withRights:flags:environment:authorizedRights:), obtain(withRight:flags:), authorizationRef())
features.apple: SFAuthorization, authorization(), init(flags:rights:environment:), obtain(withRights:...), obtain(withRight:flags:), authorizationRef()
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 24 tests. Wave 5 (w5-security-foundation, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. an app cannot ask the shell to authorize or preauthorize a named right for a privileged operation

features.feature: Per-app permission enforcement (restrict features by manifest permission)
features.apple: SFAuthorization restricts a user's access to features in an app or daemon
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/os_services/permissions.rs (Permission, Grants::from_manifest, Grants::require); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (Policy::from_permissions: network, storage, audio, notifications, documents, keychain; with_entitlements for first-party log-store)
features.note: Manifest permission names, rejection of unknown names and the require check are tested headless. Gap: the shell enforces grants at launch, an app has no run-time service to query them, and there is no user prompt for a grant.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 24 tests. Wave 5 (w5-security-foundation, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no concept of cached authorization credentials to drop

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 24 tests. Wave 5 (w5-security-foundation, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no rights or environment parameters exist in any SDK call

features.feature: Secret storage gated by an app permission
features.apple: Closest related Apple surface is Keychain Services; SFAuthorization is not a keychain API
features.note: Gated by the manifest keychain permission: without it the shell answers NotPermitted, which the SDK maps to errSecNotAvailable. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (decode_item_maps_a_failed_get_to_its_status) cover that mapping; the manifest check itself runs in the shell. Gap: there is no user authentication step and no per-right authorization, because the shell has no authentication service for secret access yet.

gaps: No SDK call for an app to request or check an authorization right (obtain / obtain withRight) before a privileged operation.
No user-facing authorization prompt that grants a right at run time; the manifest permission is the only grant.
No rights, flags or environment model in the app API.
